fields.position: An independent verifier checks the frozen specification before a candidate can enter the shared knowledge base under the cost-improvement or code-size thresholds.
fields.tradeoff: Formal proofs depend on the specification and are not a comparison on held-out tasks. The local code consumes external results and enforces the admission thresholds; it does not verify Lean.

fields.summary: Added Verified Quantum Wiki to distinguish Strategist's development-set selection from admission after independent proof against a frozen specification. The proof covers the stated properties. The local component only checks that external evidence matches the candidate and applies admission thresholds.
